articles.title: Muslims projected to outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035
articles.summary: Islam is expected to surpass Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, according to detailed projections released on Wednesday.

articles.title: Israeli troops launch ground operation in central Gaza
articles.summary: Dozens of displaced Palestinians have fled their tents and shelters in central ‌Gaza after Israel launched a rare ground operation in an area it had left under a ceasefire last year.

articles.title: William and Kate meet India's PM as they wrap up royal visit
articles.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales met the prime minister of India on Wednesday to discuss trade and bilateral ‌ties at the end of their three-day visit to the country.

articles.title: US loses measles-free status amid worst outbreak in 35 years
articles.summary: The US has lost its measles-free status after 26 years - for failing to prevent the virus spreading for more than a year.

articles.title: Democrat defeats Republican in Alaska in final midterms Senate race
articles.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan to complete a sweeping victory for the party in the Senate in the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Police in Philippines pursue three charges against Thomas Markle Sr
articles.summary: Filipino police are pursuing three charges against Thomas Markle Sr relating to child sexual abuse images, Sky News understands.

articles.title: Prague train crash leaves 46 people injured
articles.summary: Two trains have collided into each other near the main railway station in Prague, injuring 46 people.

articles.title: UK sanctions eight firms building Israeli settlements in the West Bank
articles.summary: The UK has sanctioned eight firms building Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
